items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: we played at the Swanee Inn with Shelton Brooks, Junior, and I and Rose Murphy the Chi Chi.

ctx.x: Oh, oh, that's interesting. Well we better go back to California though. Now he says after Billy Berg's you played with Paul Howard's band and T-Bone Walker?
Oh yes, yes. Yes after Billy Berg's. Then I played at Streets of Paris and then we played at the Swanee Inn with Shelton Brooks, Junior, and I and Rose Murphy the Chi Chi. She was there.
How big a band was Paul Howard's? At that time?
